responsibility: Implements the generic/default RTL hook functions and initializes the live and baseline rtl_hooks tables. It provides the standard lowpart-generation logic for regs, subregs, and mems, conservative default answers for nonzero-bit and sign-bit-copy queries and truncation knowledge, and exposes both general_rtl_hooks and mutable rtl_hooks so specialized passes can temporarily override RTL semantics and later restore the defaults.
